I am 49 years old, farmed 25 years, finished primary school. I learned everything from working the land and watching the old farmers and my neighbors. I got 90 mu here in Quzhou, Hebei. Eighty mu I do wheat in winter and maize in summer, the double crop. Ten mu I grow stevia — I started that three years back because Old Wang from Dongcun told me the buyer pays cash, and he was right, it earns more than grain.

For wheat, I plant in October. I plough the land first with the tractor service, then sow. I buy improved seed from the dealer, the same kind that gave me 1000 jin per mu last year. For fertilizer, I put one 40kg bag of 15-15-15 compound fertilizer per mu when I sow. The dealer says that means 15 percent of each thing, so that's how I know what's in it. Then at green-up in March I spread 15kg urea per mu, and at jointing stage another 15kg urea. Urea is strong stuff, 46 percent nitrogen. I don't do exact math but my neighbor Zhang uses the same and his wheat grows thick. I irrigate three times: once before winter freeze, once at jointing, and once at grain filling. My well pump can handle it. Pesticide twice: once for aphids when it warms up, once for rust before the heads come out. Last year I got 500kg per mu, this year I expect 550kg if the weather is normal.

For maize, after wheat harvest in June there is no time to waste. I use no-tillage — the seeder machine cuts through the wheat stubble and plants the seed. Hybrid maize, the yellow dent type the grain station always buys. I put one 40kg bag of compound fertilizer per mu at sowing, and at big trumpet stage I spread 25kg urea per mu. Irrigate twice: once when it's knee-high, once when the tassels silk. Pesticide twice for the corn borer. Should get 650kg per mu.

For stevia, that's on my best 10 mu near the well where the soil is loose. I plough it fine in April and plant seedlings in May. I use half a bag of compound per mu — 20kg — and 15kg urea total. I irrigate four times because the leaves must stay tender and sweet. Pesticide three times, green worms and aphids love those leaves. I expect 200kg dry leaf per mu. The buyer from Shandong drives here in October to collect.

I always worry about costs. Compound fertilizer is 120 yuan per bag, urea is 90 yuan. For 80 mu of wheat, that's 80 bags of compound right there, plus all the urea. My son works in a factory in Shijiazhuang and sends money home, and I borrow from the rural credit union every spring. Last year I tried to save money by cutting fertilizer on 5 mu of wheat — I used only half the urea. Those 5 mu yielded 100 jin less. I lost more money than I saved. Never again. I would rather put a bit too much than too little. A bad harvest is a disaster, wasting some fertilizer is just a cost. I watch what Zhang and Liu do, and we all use about the same amounts. On 90 mu I hire machines for ploughing and harvest, but for spraying and spreading fertilizer I do it myself or with my wife to save labor costs. This is my plan.
